title: Money Money More Money
desc: Four crooks kidnap a millionaire's daughter and take refuge in the home of a family of 35. Circumstances extend their stay and a motley group of people are also trapped to keep the plan from failing.

title: Cinema Chupista Maava
desc: Irresponsible Kaththi falls head over heels in love with Parineeta. However, Parineeta's father sets certain preconditions that Kaththi needs to fulfil, in order to wed her.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Mrithyunjay
desc: An aspiring crime reporter becomes suspicious when a death is ruled as accidental. Soon, when he investigates, he encounters a complex web of deception and danger.

title: S/O Satyamurthy
desc: Anand faces several challenges as he attempts to save his father's wealth while trying to handle the responsibility of earning a livelihood for his family.

title: Mangalavaaram
desc: Maaya becomes the new sub-inspector of a village gripped by mysterious murders. But as she begins to investigate, she uncovers a web of dark truths and conspiracies.

title: Siren
desc: After serving 14 years in prison, a man is released on parole. As he tries to reconnect with his family, he vows revenge against those who wronged him.

title: Gaang
desc: Enraged by the corruption that prevented him from becoming a CBI officer, a young man forms a gang posing as CBI officers and assaults the corrupt.

title: Gauravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: Kotha Bangaru Lokam
desc: Swapna, who belongs to a wealthy family, falls in love with Balu, a middle-class boy. Problems ensue when Swapna's father learns about their relationship.

title: Sarkaru Vaari Paata
desc: Mahi tries to retrieve a large amount of money she loaned to her deceitful partner. However, she uncovers a giant banking scandal on her visit.

title: Viswasam
desc: Thooku Durai, a strong and respected village leader, faces personal struggles as he tries to reunite with his estranged wife Niranjana and daughter, all while confronting challenges from his past.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Julayi
desc: When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.
